text: The hand-pulled noodles at Golden Dragon Noodle House are amazing. The broth was rich and flavorful. Chef Li Wei greeted us personally and he recommended the spicy beef soup.
The food was delicious but the service was painfully slow. We waited 45 minutes for a table on Saturday. The waiter forgot our drinks twice.
Great dumplings and friendly staff. Prices are fair at about $12 per bowl. It gets crowded after 7 pm, so come early.
Bella Napoli serves the best wood-fired pizza in Seattle. The crust is crispy and the mozzarella is fresh. Our server Maria was attentive and kind.
Terrible experience. The pizza was cold and soggy, and the manager was rude when we complained. Never again.
Decent pizza, but it is overpriced for the portion size. The patio is nice in summer. Parking near Pike Street is a nightmare.
Sunrise Cafe has the fluffiest pancakes and strong coffee. The barista remembered my order. Cozy atmosphere and fast wifi, perfect for working.
The coffee was bitter and the line was slow. The music was too loud to have a conversation. Located at 47.6097, -122.3331 downtown.
El café es excelente y el personal es muy amable. Los precios son razonables.
Taqueria El Sol makes authentic al pastor tacos. The salsa verde is fresh and spicy. Quick service even during lunch rush.
Tacos were tasty but small. The dining room was dirty and the tables were sticky. Staff were friendly though.
I got sick after eating the carnitas. The kitchen looked unclean and the cashier ignored us. Avoid this place.
